citation.authors: Pang BWJ, Yang Y, Cheon BK

cited_by.title: Intermittent fasting for women, older adults, teenagers and people with heart or thyroid conditions

record.population: 61 older men with BMI 23 or more, in a four-week alternate-day fasting programme
record.design: Randomised trial of protein or leucine supplement against none during alternate-day fasting
record.finding: Over four weeks body composition measures (not bone density), systolic blood pressure and lipids fell and muscle strength and function improved; the supplements gave no extra benefit except for diastolic blood pressure and HDL cholesterol. The authors note that fasting diets risk muscle loss in older people.
record.note: Older men only, four weeks, no comparison with eating normally; it cannot show safety for older women or over months.
